summary: Tested public /vesikalik member auth flow (register/login/logout/me/subscribe), vesikalik access-control (401 without auth, member scoped credits mode with topup), and admin regression at /admin/vesikalik. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass. Frontend: full happy path works — register with empty company, editor renders after upload, ai-credits-badge shows 0 credits then updates to 10 after p10 top-up, byok-box + open-topup-btn present, member-status reads 'Deneme', logout returns to auth screen and login re-loads editor. Admin ai-credits-badge shows 'Yönetici · Emergent'.

issues: Trial-created toast (top-right) overlaps the fixed member-bar/member-logout button for ~4s after registration; user must wait for toast to clear before logout is clickable in some cases. Consider positioning the toast at top-center or making member-bar z-index above toast.

action_items: Optional: adjust toast position vs. member-bar to avoid overlap on the top-right corner.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >4000 lines — consider splitting membership/vesikalik routers into dedicated modules for maintainability.
MemberVesikalik.logout() only calls /auth/logout and clears local state; server-side cookie invalidation appears correct but ensure /auth/logout also clears refresh_token cookie.

Frontend flows use data-testid attrs: member-auth, tab-login/register, reg-name/phone/company, auth-email/password/submit, member-bar/status/logout, ai-credits-badge, byok-box, open-topup-btn, topup-dialog, topup-buy-p10, canvas-single, subscribe-gate/btn. Note UX quirk: post-register success toast overlays member-bar top-right for a few seconds.
